summary: Connect local motion estimates into a globally consistent map while treating false matches as a failure mode.
outcomes: Explain gauge freedom and robust loop-closure validation
sequence: Accumulate drift along a toy route
Create pose nodes and relative constraints
Add and optimize a valid loop closure
Reject or downweight a false association

visual.question: Why can one incorrect loop closure bend an otherwise plausible map?
visual.interaction: Toggle candidate closures and inspect residuals and trajectory changes

practice.task: Optimize a small synthetic pose graph
practice.success: The gauge is fixed, measurement conventions match and false closures are diagnosed
